episodes.synopsis: Akira Tendo is an overworked and broken man. But one day, a sudden zombie pandemic flips his world upside down, resulting in a life-changing revelation.
episodes.title: Akira of the Dead

episodes.synopsis: Determined to make up for all his lost vacation days, Akira goes into super lazy mode — until he has to brave the zombified streets to get more beer.
episodes.title: Bucket List of the Dead

episodes.synopsis: After finding out that his old rugby buddy from college is in danger, Akira rushes over to Shinjuku to try and save him.
episodes.title: Best Friend of the Dead

episodes.synopsis: Akira and Kencho flee into the basement of a department store and meet a trio of flight attendants — checking one more item off the bucket list.
episodes.title: Flight Attendant of the Dead

episodes.synopsis: Remembering his childhood dream, Akira goes into the aquarium to grab a certain item, only to run into a group of survivors running for their lives.
episodes.title: Hero of the Dead

episodes.synopsis: Akira leaves Tokyo behind and heads back to his hometown, Gunma. When he makes a pit stop to get an RV, he reunites with Shizuka.
episodes.title: RV of the Dead

episodes.synopsis: Akira finds himself sucked right back into his old, corporate drone mindset. Seeing him in that state triggers bad memories for Shizuka.
episodes.title: Truck Stop of the Dead

episodes.synopsis: Akira and his friends meet a German college student who isn't going to let a zombie outbreak stop her from chasing her dreams.
episodes.title: Sushi & Hot Springs of the Dead

episodes.synopsis: Forced to take a detour through the forest, Akira gets very excited when he comes across a man building himself a treehouse.
episodes.title: Treehouse of the Dead

episodes.synopsis: Akira and the others settle in, helping out the villagers and their fellow refugees from Tokyo. But an old friend becomes consumed with revenge.
episodes.title: Hometown of the Dead I

episodes.synopsis: With a massive zombie horde coming their way, Akira and the others split up to try and save the villagers, only to find themselves facing another threat.
episodes.title: Hometown of the Dead II

episodes.synopsis: Faced with an impossible choice, Akira's time may have finally run out. And he hasn't even finished his bucket list yet!
episodes.title: Hometown of the Dead III
